title: Enhancing Multi-Corpus Training in SSL-Based Anti-Spoofing Models: Domain-Invariant Feature Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2603.18657v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The performance of speech spoofing detection often varies across different training and evaluation corpora. Leveraging multiple corpora typically enhances robustness and performance in fields like speaker recognition and speech recognition. However, our spoofing detection experiments show that multi-corpus training does not consistently improve performance and may even degrade it. We hypothesize that dataset-specific biases impair generalization, leading to performance instability. To address this, we propose an Invariant Domain Feature Extraction (IDFE) framework, employing multi-task learning and a gradient reversal layer to minimize corpus-specific information in learned embeddings. The IDFE framework reduces the average equal error rate by 20% compared to the baseline, assessed across four varied datasets.

translated_title: 增强基于自监督学习（SSL）的反欺骗模型中的多语料库训练：域不变特征提取
translated_abstract: 语音欺骗检测的性能往往因训练和评估语料库的不同而有所差异。在说话人识别和语音识别等领域，利用多个语料库通常能提升鲁棒性和性能。然而，我们的欺骗检测实验表明，多语料库训练并不总能提升性能，甚至可能使性能下降。我们假设数据集特有的偏差会损害模型的泛化能力，从而导致性能不稳定。为解决这一问题，我们提出了不变域特征提取（IDFE）框架，采用多任务学习和梯度反转层来最小化学习到的嵌入中的语料库特有信息。在四个不同数据集上的评估显示，与基线相比，IDFE框架将平均等错误率降低了20%。
tldr: 提出不变域特征提取（IDFE）框架，通过多任务学习和梯度反转层消除语料库特有偏差，使基于SSL的反欺骗模型在多语料库训练下的平均等错误率降低20%。
en_tdlr: Proposing an Invariant Domain Feature Extraction (IDFE) framework that uses multi-task learning and a gradient reversal layer to remove corpus-specific biases, reducing the average equal error rate of SSL-based anti-spoofing models by 20% in multi-corpus training.
